units: Pixels at 1000 px full image width, origin top left. Wheel registration uses only the two raised terminal faces; seven lower wheel centres are withheld.
order: Wheel centres: rear, front, seven lower wheels from rear to front. Bolt centres: clockwise in the image, starting at the highest bolt.

SKTB4.scope: Different snow view. Flange identified by its bolt circle; cutting lip and shaft centre obscured. P028 is the same exposure.

picking: Full-resolution crop on each scan. Bolt positions are centroids of isolated bright components at thresholds 165/190 for SKTB2/P014; visual cross-check and sensitivity at 145/185 and 170/210. Silvery circular mark on the cheek is a tentative axle witness. Treat flange depth, axle identity and transverse offsets as C.
